correctness.rationale: Double integrals on same and distinct arms give exact moments. On the normalized simplex the Schur derivative quotient for mean is 2(1-x-y), raw second moment is 2((x+y)(1-x-y)+R2), positive for m>=3. Three-arm variance quotient 2z(1+12xyz)/3>0. Exact rational four-arm majorization transfer decreases variance by 203133/8000000000, and adding small identical arms preserves reversal by continuity. Equal arms near uniform increase variance, excluding Schur concavity. Two-arm star is an interval; boundaries correctly handled for positive lengths.
